text: うみに　でてると　たまーに　クラゲ　ポケモンが　ながれて　くるぜ

structure.jp: クラゲ　ポケモンが　ながれて　くるぜ

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb means 'whenever this happens, that follows'. でてる is the short form of でている, 'be out'. うみに　でてると = 'when you're out at sea'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb says the action moves toward the speaker. ながれて　くる = 'come drifting this way'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, casual male speech that adds a confident 'I'm telling you'. ながれて　くるぜ = 'they come drifting by, you know'.
